HSIMS.wp.mats.M30.t|/steps/0: Put 4.5–5.25 l of water per 25 kg into a clean mixing bucket and add the powder.
HSIMS.wp.mats.M30.t|/steps/1: Mix approx. 3 minutes to a homogeneous, lump-free mass.
HSIMS.wp.mats.M30.t|/note: Stirrer approx. 500–700 rpm. Do not add water or new mortar to mortar that has already set.
HSIMS.wp.mats.AQ1K.t|/steps/0: Put approx. 6.7 l of water per 25 kg (26–27 %) into a clean mixing bucket and add the powder.
HSIMS.wp.mats.AQ1K.t|/steps/1: Mix approx. 3 minutes to a homogeneous, lump-free mass.
HSIMS.wp.mats.AQ1K.t|/note: Stirrer approx. 500–700 rpm. Do not add water or new mortar to mortar that has already set (risk of inadequate strength development).
HSIMS.wp.mats.RB400.t|/steps/0: Put the liquid component B into a clean mixing bucket and add the powder component A (A : B = 1.5 : 1 by weight).
HSIMS.wp.mats.RB400.t|/steps/1: Mix approx. 3 minutes to a homogeneous, lump-free mass.
HSIMS.wp.mats.RB400.t|/steps/3: Homogenise the compound thoroughly again. Water only after mixing: max. 0.24 l per 24 kg.
HSIMS.wp.mats.RB400.t|/steps/4: Pot life approx. 45 minutes at approx. 5–30 °C.
HSIMS.wp.mats.RB400.t|/note: Stirrer approx. 500–700 rpm. Do not add water or new material to material that has already set.
HSIMS.wp.t|/gate/title: Waterproof the basement wall from the inside, with your own hands
HSIMS.wp.t|/gate/desc: The concrete basement wall of the 3D sample — jetted, repaired, pre-sealed and coated twice with AQUAFIN-RB400 against pressing water from the rear. You guide the lance, the chipping hammer and the trowel, mix every material with its mixing and maturing time, brush, trowel and spray the coats yourself to the material rate of the technical data sheet, and keep the pot life. No site, no risk: repeat it as often as you like.
HSIMS.wp.t|/gate/foot: Thirteen phases from the technical data sheets of ASOCRET-M30, AQUAFIN-1K and AQUAFIN-RB400; the site clock runs through the waiting times.
HSIMS.wp.t|/eyebrow: Operation briefing · Basement wall, from the inside
HSIMS.wp.t|/sub: An existing concrete basement wall lets water through at a construction joint and at honeycombed zones; the old paint flakes. The outside cannot be dug up. Prepare, repair and pre-seal the wall, then coat it twice with AQUAFIN-RB400 to ≥ 3.0 mm dry film — flexible and crack-bridging, against pressing water from the negative side (WTA 4-6, up to 0.75 bar).
HSIMS.wp.t|/brief/0: Jet the face at > 400 bar, break out the honeycombs
HSIMS.wp.t|/brief/1: Fill pockets, tie holes and the chased joint with ASOCRET-M30; sealing cove
HSIMS.wp.t|/brief/2: Pre-seal with AQUAFIN-1K brushed in, ≤ 1 mm per step
HSIMS.wp.t|/brief/3: The joint band of AQUAFIN-RB400, 15 cm on both sides
HSIMS.wp.t|/brief/4: First coat RB400 with the trowel, second after 3 hours — ≥ 3.0 mm dry film
HSIMS.wp.t|/brief/5: Keep damp for at least 3 days
HSIMS.wp.t|/phases/0/p: Select the jet lance and hold the pointer on the nozzle: the face is jetted from the top down at > 400 bar until paint and lime runs are gone and the concrete is laid bare, matt damp.
HSIMS.wp.t|/phases/0/done: Substrate laid bare, pore-open, matt damp.
HSIMS.wp.t|/phases/1/p: Select the chipping hammer and stay with it: the honeycombed zones are broken out to sound concrete, the edges cut square.
HSIMS.wp.t|/phases/1/done: Honeycombs broken out to sound concrete.
HSIMS.wp.t|/phases/2/p: Mix ASOCRET-M30, then guide the trowel: pockets and tie holes are filled, the chased construction joint filled flush from the bottom up (3–30 mm in one step).
HSIMS.wp.t|/phases/2/done: Pockets, tie holes and joint filled flush.
HSIMS.wp.t|/phases/3/p: Mix AQUAFIN-1K for the bonding slurry. Brush it along the wall–floor joint, then form the sealing cove of ASOCRET-M30 wet in wet, edge height ≥ 4 cm, rounded.
HSIMS.wp.t|/phases/3/done: Sealing cove formed on its bonding slurry.
HSIMS.wp.t|/phases/4/p: The cementitious cove can be overcoated after approx. 3 hours. The mixed material in the buckets goes off meanwhile — fresh batches for the next step.
HSIMS.wp.t|/phases/5/p: Mix AQUAFIN-1K and brush it into the matt damp wall and the floor strip yourself: drag over the surfaces with the brush, pore-deep, approx. 1.75 kg/m² (≤ 1 mm per step; more than 2 kg/m² in one step can crack).
HSIMS.wp.t|/phases/5/done: Pre-sealed — the rigid slurry keeps the moisture from the rear off the flexible coating.
HSIMS.wp.t|/phases/6/p: AQUAFIN-1K is overcoated after approx. 6 hours. The site clock runs.
HSIMS.wp.t|/phases/7/p: Mix AQUAFIN-RB400 (A : B = 1.5 : 1, 3 minutes, mature 5 minutes, homogenise). Guide the notched trowel over the construction joint, 15 cm on both sides, to ≥ 4.0 mm dry film, then smooth.
HSIMS.wp.t|/phases/7/done: Construction joint reinforced with the band of RB400.
HSIMS.wp.t|/phases/8/p: Trowel the first coat yourself over wall and floor strip, free of pores: an even thickness with the coating-thickness trowel, approx. 1.8 kg/m² (1.5 mm dry). Keep the pot life of 45 minutes.
HSIMS.wp.t|/phases/8/done: First coat applied, free of pores.
HSIMS.wp.t|/phases/9/p: The second application step follows when the first can no longer be damaged by reworking — after approx. 3 hours. Mix a fresh batch.
HSIMS.wp.t|/phases/10/p: Spray or trowel the second coat over the first, free of pores, approx. 1.8 kg/m²: the two coats give ≥ 3.0 mm dry film for pressing water (≥ 2.0 mm would be soil moisture only).
HSIMS.wp.t|/phases/10/done: Second coat applied — the thick-layer coating is complete.
HSIMS.wp.t|/phases/11/p: Select the hose and keep the fresh coating damp; it is protected from draught, sun and direct heating. 1 bar after approx. 16 hours, pressurised water after ≥ 1 day.
HSIMS.wp.t|/phases/12/p: Kept damp ≥ 3 days. The flexible, crack-bridging, radon-tight coating holds the pressing water from the rear.
HSIMS.wp.t|/res_title: The wall is waterproofed. Flexible, crack-bridging, radon-tight.
HSIMS.wp.t|/res_sub: Plaster, tiles or a coating may follow once the system has cured. Clean the tools with water immediately after use. Observe the technical data sheets and the safety data sheets.
HSIMS.rc.mats.F20.t|/steps/0: Approx. 200–250 g of water per kg of powder into a clean bucket — a small quantity only, what can be placed at once.
HSIMS.rc.mats.F20.t|/steps/1: Mix at least approx. 1 minute to a homogeneous, lump-free mass. Gloves!
HSIMS.rc.mats.F20.t|/steps/2: Solidification starts after 1–2 minutes: pot life approx. 2 minutes.
HSIMS.rc.mats.F20.t|/note: Low temperatures: warm water and pre-warmed powder; high temperatures: cool water — the powder must not exceed +23 °C.
HSIMS.rc.mats.IM.t|/steps/0: 3.75–4.25 l of water per 25 kg into a clean mixing bucket, the powder in.
HSIMS.rc.mats.IM.t|/steps/1: Mix approx. 3 minutes to a homogeneous, lump-free mass of filler consistency.
HSIMS.rc.mats.IM.t|/steps/2: Pot life approx. 30 minutes at approx. 5–30 °C.
HSIMS.rc.mats.IM.t|/note: Stirrer approx. 500–700 rpm. Up to 10 mm per application step.
HSIMS.rc.mats.IC.t|/steps/0: 6.75–8 l of water per 25 kg (27–32 %) into a clean mixing bucket; add the powder while stirring vigorously.
HSIMS.rc.mats.IC.t|/steps/1: Mix approx. 3 minutes until homogeneous and clump-free.
HSIMS.rc.mats.IC.t|/steps/4: Pot life approx. 60 minutes at approx. 5–30 °C.
HSIMS.rc.mats.IC.t|/note: Stirrer approx. 500–700 rpm; liquid consistency, density approx. 1.6 kg/dm³.
HSIMS.rc.t|/gate/title: Stop the water and make the wall crystalline with your own hands
HSIMS.rc.t|/gate/desc: The leaking basement wall of the 3D sample: the running water stopped with a plug of FIX-20-T within its two-minute pot life, the joint chased and filled with ASOCRET-IM on a screen of AQUAFIN-IC, the coved fillet, then two coats of AQUAFIN-IC brushed into the matt damp concrete to 1.5 kg/m² — you guide the tools, mix with the maturing times, brush the coats yourself and let the crystals grow.
HSIMS.rc.t|/gate/foot: Eleven phases from the technical data sheets of FIX-20-T, ASOCRET-IM and AQUAFIN-IC; the site clock runs through the waiting times.
HSIMS.rc.t|/eyebrow: Operation briefing · Basement wall, negative pressing water
HSIMS.rc.t|/title: Crystalline waterproofing from the inside with AQUAFIN-IC
HSIMS.rc.t|/sub: Ground water presses through a construction joint of the concrete basement wall: the joint leaks, lime leaches out, at its foot the water runs in. The outside cannot be dug up. Stop the water, chase and fill the joint, form the cove, then brush two coats of AQUAFIN-IC into the matt damp concrete: the crystals grow into the capillaries and hold the pressing water back — up to 1.5 bar from the negative side.
HSIMS.rc.t|/brief/0: Jet both walls at > 400 bar; chase the joint 20 × 25 mm; chisel the leak to a dovetail
HSIMS.rc.t|/brief/1: Wet to matt damp — no puddles
HSIMS.rc.t|/brief/2: Plug the running water with FIX-20-T, pressed in by hand and held until it hardens
HSIMS.rc.t|/brief/3: Screen with AQUAFIN-IC, fill with ASOCRET-IM wet in wet; coved fillet approx. 4 cm
HSIMS.rc.t|/brief/4: Two coats of AQUAFIN-IC, 1.5 kg/m² in total for pressing water
HSIMS.rc.t|/phases/0/p: Select the jet lance and hold the pointer on the nozzle: the back wall and the right wall are jetted from the top down at > 400 bar until the concrete is pore-open and absorbent.
HSIMS.rc.t|/phases/0/done: Substrate pore-open, free of adhesion-inhibiting substances.
HSIMS.rc.t|/phases/1/p: Select the chipping hammer and stay with it: the construction joint is chased 20 mm wide and 25 mm deep; where the water runs out, the opening is chiselled to a dovetail for the plug.
HSIMS.rc.t|/phases/1/done: Joint chased 20 × 25 mm, the leak dovetailed.
HSIMS.rc.t|/phases/2/p: Select the hose and dampen walls and floor with clean water: matt damp at the time of application, no puddles. Repeated moistening favours the growth of the crystals.
HSIMS.rc.t|/phases/3/p: Mix a small quantity of FIX-20-T. Hold the pointer on the leak: the plug is pressed into the dovetailed opening by hand and held until it hardens — after 1–2 minutes, with a noticeable warming. Within the pot life of 2 minutes!
HSIMS.rc.t|/phases/3/done: The water is stopped. FIX-20-T solidifies even under water and swells against the concrete.
HSIMS.rc.t|/phases/4/p: Mix AQUAFIN-IC and ASOCRET-IM. Brush the screen of IC into the chased joint, then fill it flush with IM wet in wet, up to 10 mm per step (approx. 1.3 kg per metre of 20 × 25 mm).
HSIMS.rc.t|/phases/4/done: Joint and crack filled flush on a screen of AQUAFIN-IC.
HSIMS.rc.t|/phases/5/p: Guide brush and trowel along the wall–floor joint and up the corner: the substrate screened with AQUAFIN-IC, ASOCRET-IM applied wet in wet with an edge height of approx. 4 cm, rounded.
HSIMS.rc.t|/phases/5/done: Coved fillet formed — part of the crystalline system.
HSIMS.rc.t|/phases/6/p: After approx. 1–3 hours the fresh mortar is reworked with AQUAFIN-IC. The batches in the buckets have gone off — mix fresh.
HSIMS.rc.t|/phases/7/p: Mix AQUAFIN-IC and brush the first coat yourself into the matt damp concrete — wall, floor strip, over the filled joint and the fresh fillet: evenly, worked in meticulously, free of pores, approx. 0.75 kg/m².
HSIMS.rc.t|/phases/8/p: Brush the second coat while the first is still sticky and has not dried out: approx. 0.75 kg/m² more — 1.5 kg/m² in two layers for accumulated and pressing water.
HSIMS.rc.t|/phases/8/done: Second coat applied; drying of the first was avoided.
HSIMS.rc.t|/phases/9/p: Select the hose: jute sheets are hung and the coating is kept damp, the room ventilated — no condensation, no direct heating. The crystals grow into the capillaries.
HSIMS.rc.t|/phases/10/p: Kept damp ≥ 3 days. Foot traffic after approx. 5 hours; withstands pressurised water after ≥ 7 days.
HSIMS.rc.t|/res_title: The wall is dry. The crystals hold the pressing water back.
HSIMS.rc.t|/res_sub: Negative pressing water up to 1.5 bar; cracks up to 0.4 mm heal when water reaches them. Movement and connecting joints take the ASO-Dichtband system. Observe the technical data sheets and the safety data sheets.
HSIMS.cr.mats.HSF.t|/steps/0: Approx. 5.5–5.75 l of water per 25 kg into a clean mixing bucket, the powder in — the consistency for the corrosion protection.
HSIMS.cr.mats.HSF.t|/note: Approx. 1.6 kg/m² per mm; approx. 1 mm per application step.
HSIMS.cr.mats.HSFB.t|/steps/0: Approx. 6.75–7.0 l of water per 25 kg — the brushable consistency of the bond coat.
HSIMS.cr.mats.HSFB.t|/note: Approx. 1.5 kg/m² per mm. In case of interruptions the bond coat must set completely; then repeat it.
HSIMS.cr.mats.BIS540.t|/steps/0: Put approx. 2.8–3.0 l of water into a clean mixing bucket and add 25 kg of powder.
HSIMS.cr.mats.BIS540.t|/steps/1: Pre-mix approx. 3 minutes to a homogeneous, lump-free mass.
HSIMS.cr.mats.BIS540.t|/steps/2: Add the remaining water: in total approx. 3.5–3.75 l.
HSIMS.cr.mats.BIS540.t|/steps/3: Mix sufficiently (forced paddle mixer for larger quantities).
